semiconductor_relevance: High — the company produces rare earth materials that are essential for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Fujian Golden Dragon Rare-Earth Co., Ltd. specializes in the separation and processing of rare earth materials, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and other high-tech applications. Their production capabilities include high-purity rare earth oxides and functional materials used in various sectors, including electronics and display technologies.
capabilities: Production of high-purity rare earth oxides
Manufacturing of rare earth functional materials
technical_expertise: Deep processing of rare earth materials

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Fujian Province, where it operates significant production facilities for rare earth materials.
